main_experiment.purpose: single-dataset fair comparison of every LEGO method and required baseline
main_experiment.fairness_rule: All methods use the same normalized records, group split, task model, decision budget, evaluator and feedback schedule.

primary_dataset.name: HelpSteer2-Preference
primary_dataset.reason: It provides response groups per prompt with five human rating dimensions; group-relative preference labels can be derived deterministically while preserving the raw scores.
required_checks: available fields and stable record identifiers
whether derived group-relative labels are acceptable for the intended evaluation
enough independent prompt groups for seed, held_in, held_out and final_test
explicitly report that it has no user/session identity and no rationale field

auxiliary_datasets.name: CoAuthor
auxiliary_datasets.use: longer writing sessions and ordered interaction batches
auxiliary_datasets.required_check: construct a defensible task target without treating rejection as a hard negative

auxiliary_datasets.name: PRISM
auxiliary_datasets.use: user/session variation and delayed preference analysis
auxiliary_datasets.required_check: preserve user/session grouping and do not merge users into one preference stream

batch_policy.initial_seed: 10 source cases when the dataset supports it
batch_policy.stream: successive source batches with no duplication to fill length
batch_policy.feedback_scope: feedback is attached to its original candidate and cannot score a later candidate directly
